title: SoroBeacon — Notification Channels & Circuit Breakers
description: Per-channel health, circuit breaker states (closed / half-open / open), error ratios, and rate-limit throttling across all 26 channel types.

panels.title: Open Circuit Breakers by Channel
panels.description: Good: 0 open circuit breakers. Any channel with state="open" == 1 has tripped due to repeated downstream failures.

panels.title: Half-Open Circuit Breakers (Probing Recovery)
panels.description: Good: 0 half-open breakers in steady state. Shows channels currently testing whether a downstream endpoint has recovered.

panels.title: Channel Delivery Success Ratio by Type (15m)
panels.description: Good: 1.0 (100%) per channel type. Isolates whether failures are specific to one provider (e.g. Slack vs PagerDuty).

panels.title: Channel Throttling Rate by Type
panels.description: Good: 0 throttles/sec. Indicates which channel types are hitting configured rate limits.
